review_candidates.title: Signaling Commissioning Engineer @Siemens Mobility Egypt
review_candidates.description: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide. Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services. In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is implementing the European safety standards “ European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 1” . Spanning 950 km, this project is part of the broader Egypt National Railways Projects and aims to enhance the safety standards, increase the number of passenger trains, and boost freight capacity. Today, we are recruiting for a Signaling Commissioning Engineer to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility. What are my responsibilities? Perform commissioning activities for railway systems, components, software, and technical solutions at installation sites. Analyze system performance, execute testing activities, and document commissioning results and reports. Plan and coordinate commissioning activities while ensuring timely execution and compliance with project requirements. Support system optimization through parameter settings and technical adjustments when required. Conduct customer handover activities and provide technical briefings and training to customer personnel. Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards while maintaining a safe working environment on site. Report site issues that may lead to claims or change orders and contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives. Collaborate with project teams and, where required, provide functional guidance to commissioning personnel on site. What do I need to qualify for this job? Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automation & Control Engineering, or a related field. Up to 1 year of engineering experience in testing, commissioning, or field activities within the railway industry (recent graduates are encouraged to apply). Strong interest in rail technologies and sustainable mobility solutions. Willingness to learn Siemens-specific software and hardware platforms. Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills with a flexible and reliable working style. Comfortable using digital tools including laptops, tablets, and engineering applications. Fluency in both English and Arabic is mandatory. What else do I need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant, that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

review_candidates.title: Maintenance Engineer - Mechanical Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Overview We Are PepsiCo PepsiCo is a leading name in North Africa’s food and beverage industry, where our products are enjoyed by consumers daily across the region. We offer a robust portfolio of beloved brands like PEPSI, SEVEN-UP, DORITOS, CHEETOS and CHIPSY, designed to cater to the tastes and preferences of consumers. With a focus on local sourcing, production, and distribution, PepsiCo provides essential support to local economies and partners closely with communities throughout the region. Guiding Vision and Regional Impact PepsiCo’s vision aligns with our global goal to be the Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+). This strategic transformation is committed to sustainable growth by putting people and the planet at the heart of our operations. In North Africa, this includes initiatives in responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and water conservation. Our regional programs empower local talent, boost employment, and provide support for local agriculture, particularly through partnerships with farmers and suppliers. Empowering Our People and Communities Our dynamic teams drive the PepsiCo culture in North Africa, embracing diversity and collaboration to solve local challenges and create innovative products. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace, one where every individual feels valued and empowered to be themselves. This commitment extends beyond our employees to positively impact the communities we serve, striving for shared growth and a healthier, more sustainable future for all. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment PepsiCo stands firmly behind our global commitment to diversity, equality, and human rights. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, ensuring a fair and welcoming workplace for all, regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. Our dedication to inclusion strengthens our workforce and helps drive our business forward, enriching both PepsiCo and the communities in North Africa. Responsible for Mechanical Maintenance Scope on Production lines and managing technician performance KPIs, Technical Skills to support achieving plant AOP targets. Responsibilities Maintain the equipment within the required efficiencies. Applying maintenance procedures and ensure people and equipment safety. Lead the working team administratively and technically on daily basis. Achieve and analyze maintenance KPIs and issue periodic follow-up reports. Achieve & follow-up weekly electricity, water, gas consumptions. Control the maintenance expenses on a weekly basis. Cooperate with Purchasing & Engineering team for any technical issues. Revise spare parts strategic items on annual basis. Revise the work orders completion with spare parts withdrawal. Review and modify the spare parts item cards limits to ensure Spare Parts. Availability. Review and sign on purchasing orders and technically approve supplier’s offers. Revise, check and approve imported spare parts orders. Participate in planning and preparation for projects. Annual revise for equipment fixed assists registry. Complete the organization structure for his team as per the standard crew Responsible for implementing AIB, TPM, EMS & ERP PEMM systems. Enhance the equipment performance by updating the PM programs. Control team overtime and annual leaves according to the work needs. Raising-up team skills by internal technical training and coach new TLs. Qualifications Internal Clients: PC Process – Corn Process – Packaging – Safety – Food Safety – Utilities – Quality –Sustainability. External Clients: Spare Parts suppliers - Contractors Skills: Mechanical engineer background Previous experience in the same field at least 1 year. Good knowledge about Mechanical equipment, Pumps, heat transfer, Rotating equipment & power transmission Leadership skills Communication & Presentation skills Work under pressure. Good computer skills Time Management Problems Analysis and solving
